data.sub: Allahabad HC ne APO bharti ka prarambhik result radd kiya.

chat.say: Sir, abhi padhna shuru hi kiya tha ki result hi badal gaya!
Koi baat nahi, dobara taiyaari ka mauka mil gaya hai.

data.asar: Jin students ka exam tha, unhe dobara intezaar karna hoga.
data.caption:
APO exam dene walon ke liye badi khabar! Allahabad HC ne prarambhik result radd kar diya hai.

⚖️ Prarambhik result radd
⚖️ Nayi merit list banegi
⚖️ Dobara aayega result

Padhai waale doston ke sath yeh update share kar lo taaki sabko pata chal jaye!

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega.
